name: Tashkeela (Misraj/Sadeed_Tashkeela repack)
license: GPL-2 (upstream Tashkeela); card has no license field
schema: parquet: vocalized/bare/text splits (3 train shards + test)
usage_notes: LOCAL ALREADY. Largest staged vocalized corpus; stage1 used 148.2M chars. GPL-2 heritage: COMMERCIAL/REDISTRIBUTION = USER DECISION FLAG.

name: Abdou Arabic Tashkeel Dataset
size: 1,463,790 train + 30,181 valid + 15,091 test rows; 3.72GB dataset_size / 3.52GB download
usage_notes: LOCAL ALREADY (5.6GB). Mix: Tashkeela 45% + Shamela 42% + Wikipedia 6.64% SYNTHETIC (GPT-4o-mini diacritized - do not treat Wikipedia slice as gold) + ashaar 2.9% + quran 1.77% + hadith 1.54%. stage1 used 181.1M chars.

name: Fadel 2019 benchmark split (AliOsm)
source: GitHub: AliOsm/arabic-text-diacritization (MIT, 80 stars); paper arXiv:1905.01965 (IEEE CAIS 2019)
size: train 34.3MB / val 1.67MB / test 1.75MB (~1.75M words total per repo)
license: MIT (repo license verified via GitHub API)
usage_notes: LOCAL ALREADY. Standard benchmark for diac model SOTA claims; classical-shamela-flavored test lines. stage1 used 11.0M chars. Contamination: big classical corpora may include its source text (E-23 bench uses test as a pure gate).

name: QCRI Wikipedia Diacritized Corpus (clone)
license: unknown (no LICENSE file; repo says 'publicly shareable resources')
vocalization: fully diacritized but by a BiLSTM MODEL (WER ~3% on WikiNews-2014) - synthetic gold
usage_notes: LOCAL ALREADY (qcri_diac_clone + own derived qcri_gatesafe.jsonl 83.5MB). Largest free fully-vocalized MSA corpus that exists; assume model-generated labels. stage1 used 29.8M chars.

name: WikiNews-2014 benchmark (multi-ref)
license: unknown; 'CC terms per repo' per provenance.json (research)
schema: .diac txt (vocalized text with ref files); eval script EvalDiac.java
usage_notes: LOCAL ALREADY. THE benchmark referenced by CATT/Abdou/QCRI. EVAL-ONLY for our rungs (bench report in data/diac/bench).

name: WikiNews-2024 benchmark (multi-ref)
license: unknown; 'CC terms per repo' per provenance.json
usage_notes: LOCAL ALREADY. Fresh 2024 curators benchmark; E-23 gate uses it (prep_rawlm_override wn2024=0 zero-holdout).

name: SadeedDiac-25
size: 1,200 paragraphs (600 MSA incl 146 from WikiNews; 600 CA from Fadel-test); 1.45MB
license: unknown (card does NOT state license; gate-verify before redistribution)
usage_notes: LOCAL ALREADY (sadeed25.parquet 678KB). Cleanest 2025 MSA+CA benchmark. 46.8% exact shingle overlap vs our sadeed_tashkeela train (data/diac/bench/sadeed_overlap_report.json OVERLAP-FLAGGED) -> EVAL-ONLY.

name: E-23c ZM Labels ( Zambia/Muath label sets)
task_type: other (derived vocal-label tables for G4 eval)
license: internal (project artifact; carries upstream license of parents)
usage_notes: LOCAL ONLY. E-23 ZM-leave labels used at G4 mark-selection eval; not a train corpus.

name: Tashkeela original (community-datasets)
source: PMC5310197 / 10.1016/j.dib.2017.01.011 (Tashkeela paper); upstream project of OhadRubin et al.
usage_notes: Original vocalized Shamela-derived corpus. Our local sadeed_tashkeela already covers most of it; grab at book granularity (97 docs) for better context field.

name: Tashkeela (arbml repack)
size: 979,982 train + 54,444 test + 54,443 dev rows; 1.58GB dataset_size; dl 747MB
usage_notes: Sentence-split variant with a held-out test set - fallback clean eval variant if sadeed_tashkeela diverges from upstream.

name: Tashkeelav2 (arbml)
usage_notes: Cleanup pass of arbml v1; low downloads (55) - only if v1 has a known bug that v2 fixes.

name: Roots-G5 ar_tashkeela (bigscience-data)
usage_notes: ROOTS subset pre-sliced to sentences - matches our G2 window style; gated(auto) on HF.

name: Athar-Shamela4
source: HF: Kandil7/Athar-Shamela4 (Exa answer cites ~19GB; >8,500 classical books)
usage_notes: Jackpot candidate if verified: 19GB fully vocalized classical; MUST vet tashkeel-rate (filter >70% characters for speech-safety) + Shamela.ws TOS.

name: Shamela (ReligiousLLMs repack)
size: ~1.67GB portion inside Abdou dataset; full repo unknown size
license: unknown (ReligiousLLMs card has no license; shamela.ws TOS unknown)
usage_notes: Same content already inside Abdou train (42% share) - skip unless we need uncapped classical LADDER pretrain.

name: CATT benchmark
source: HF: Bisher/CATT_benchmark + GitHub abjadai/catt; paper arXiv:2407.03236
license: Apache-2.0 (catt repo verified); upstream text license unclear
usage_notes: Second standard benchmark after WikiNews-2014; keep as eval-only, small.

name: Google wiki40b (ar split)
task_type: raw-LM (bare text mostly, some pages with vocalization)
license: data card license blank; content effectively CC-BY-SA 3.0/GFDL (Wikipedia)
usage_notes: Pretrained LM corpus (fast access, flat text, per-article hierarchy). Useful only if a diacritization-rate pre-filter is applied.

name: wikimedia/wikipedia (20231101.ar)
usage_notes: Cleanest bare-Arabic pretraining body; pairs with Abdou vocalized for (vocalized vs bare) mixtures.

name: mC4 / allenai c4 (ar subset)
source: HF: allenai/c4 (config multilingual, ar); AllenAI C4 / C4-200M etc.
usage_notes: Unfiltered dirty web crawl with dedup; strong generic pretrain only - NOT vocalized.

name: CALM / arwiki
usage_notes: Alternative flattened Wikipedia - adds nothing beyond wikimedia/wikipedia 20231101.ar.

name: OSCAR 22.01 / mOSCAR (ar subset)
size: mOSCAR ar-classified slice; mOSCAR ~32B tokens total
usage_notes: Web-crawl mixed-language with ar slice; one pilot shard for G1 bare-text mixing is enough.

name: Arabic Wikipedia 2023-01-01 no-bots
license: MIT per card; content is Wikipedia CC-BY-SA 3.0/GFDL
usage_notes: Second cleaned bare-Arabic source; alternative to wikimedia/wikipedia.

name: AraTweets
size: millions of tweets across Arabic dialects
usage_notes: Only dialectal social-media bare set with a clean CC-BY license - nice G1 diversity slice; not vocalized so not for the vocalization rungs.

name: ArabicaQA
usage_notes: MSA comprehension QA - not a rawLM body; only relevant if we later add MSA reading-prompt rungs (out of current scope).

name: Alpaca-Arabic (instruct)
usage_notes: Relevant only if we later add G5 'diacritize via instruction' - out of current four rungs.

name: Arabic-English code-switching
usage_notes: Code-switch slice: not vocalized, tiny, license unclear; out of scope for the tashkeel rungs.

name: ZAEBUC (CAMeL-Lab bilingual essays)
source: GitHub: CAMeL-Lab/zaebuc; LREC 2026 / ZAEBUC paper LREC 2022
license: MIT (code); data research-only per LREC paper
usage_notes: Dialect-adjacent bilingual essays with morphology; not useful for the four vocalization rungs themselves.

name: CAMeL Tools / camel_data open corpora
source: GitHub: CAMeL-Team/CAMeL-Tools (+CAMeL-Lab/camel_morph; camel_data_open bundle: EMA, KHA, ARZ, BSA etc.)
license: MIT code; corpora carry their own licenses per dataset
usage_notes: Analyzer suite not a dataset; heavy to set up and license-fragmented; out of the char-LM ladder.

name: Farasa (QCRI)
usage_notes: Diacritizer/segmenter TOOL not a dataset; useful as reference baseline only.

name: KACST Arabic Language Database (KALD)
size: 40M-word speech corpus + hours of audio with text transcripts
license: research-only, KACST licensing; not openly distributed
usage_notes: SPEECH corpus; no open download hub; not fetchable here.

name: KSUCCA (King Saud University Classical Arabic Corpus)
source: King Saud University; secondary host Sketch Engine (paper 81860)
license: research access via Sketch Engine; no open snapshot
usage_notes: Classical Arabic 50M-word reference; access is BEHIND Sketch-Engine (not directly downloadable); useful only as baseline reference.

name: Quranic Arabic Corpus
license: research-only GPL-license notes on download page
usage_notes: Fully-vocalized small classical Quran body + rich morphology. Well-matched to G2/G3 Quran rungs if a different gold from Abdou quran-riwayat is needed.

name: Tanzil Quran texts
size: full Quran in ~10 riwayat; Uthmani + Imlaeki notations
usage_notes: Attribution-only (BY) but No-Derivatives restricts text modification - use inside training OK if no derived texts are redistributed.

name: Misraj mudd (gated research group data)
usage_notes: Misraj group gated data room - may contain tashkeel + MSA instruction data; only request access if we later need Arabic SFT.

name: NADI 2025 (multidialectal speech)
usage_notes: Dialectal speech; transcript-level tashkeel restoration only; no dataset files here.

name: YAMAMA (multi-dialect morphological analyzer)
source: Yamama Analyzer (paper YAMAMA; approach of YaMDA)
usage_notes: Dialectal morph analyzer; not useful for the vocalization ladder.

name: Arabic Corpus 2B
usage_notes: Very large but 'other' license, no vocalization - only if bare-text mixing is wanted.

name: riotu-lab tashkeel-arabic-sentences
usage_notes: Small vocalized-sentence mirror; redundant but license freer - check exact CC flavor.
